legacy_default.reason: superstage S1 defines an unmarked root as legacy incremental regardless of SUPER_PLANNING_MODE and forbids auto-conversion.

invalid_trailing_planning_mode.reason: supergoal input gate accepts only upfront or incremental and rejects another trailing explicit mode before scratch or vault writes.

incremental_mode_persisted.reason: supergoal requires a newly authored incremental root to carry the exact Planning mode: incremental marker.

bounded_unknown.reason: superstage S2 permits bounded predecessor-dependent filenames with a stated resolution method, but S3 requires a current PREPARED receipt for execution.

missing_architecture.reason: superstage S2 forbids deferring architecture without bounded alternatives, criteria, evidence, or a discovery-stage contract.

open_provider.reason: superstage S3 says an open code PR and closeout are not integrated delivery; the dependent contract remains unsatisfied.

declined_provider.reason: superstage S3 says a provider decline does not deliver to a live consumer; an adopted replan must remove or replace that dependency before completion.

dependency_cycle.reason: superstage S2 classifies cycles in active dependencies as a graph-validation fault.

temporary_upfront_gate.reason: supertraverse C6 Task 1 transition gate returns BLOCKED for every upfront selection until Tasks 3 and 5 install preparation and routing consumers.

unlinked_active_row.reason: superstage S2 requires no blank active Plan cells and forbids repairing a published upfront graph through incremental gap filling.

multi_level_complete_tree.reason: The mapped scratch tree has unique active IDs, complete S2 contracts, compatible dependencies, and a passing intended-vault review; initial Preparation: none leaves are valid but unexecutable under S3.

draft_interrupted_before_confirmation.reason: supergoal keeps the fully drafted upfront tree in scratch until confirmation; interruption after review reports DRAFT-INCOMPLETE and does no code work.

resume_identical_source.reason: supergoal resume reuses a matching scratch set, intended paths, and stable IDs, but reapplies the current confirmation gate and cannot publish from draft existence alone.

resume_changed_source.reason: supergoal requires an explicitly revised scratch draft when the saved source digest differs, preserving the old draft and reporting DRAFT-INCOMPLETE.

confirmation_refused.reason: supergoal step 7 says a declined confirmation writes nothing and preserves the scratch index as DRAFT-INCOMPLETE; no execution occurs.

supermeta_draft_incomplete.reason: supermeta step 6 preserves a reported DRAFT-INCOMPLETE index and writes nothing to the iteration ledger without complete goal-folder publication evidence.

local_detail.reason: superstage S4 assigns bounded file placement, helper, and test-detail changes that preserve commitments to PLAN_REFINER refinement.

contract_break.reason: superstage S4 requires REPLANNER replanning when shared contract behavior cannot be preserved for downstream consumers.

preparation_noop.reason: superstage S5 defines a first attached receipt with no plan-body amendment as PREPARED, amendment none, with Stage revision unchanged.

predecessor_detail_preparation.reason: superstage S4 permits refinement of bounded predecessor-proven placement, helper, and test details; S5 calls the resulting body change a content-amendment and increments revision.

scope_expansion_during_preparation.reason: superrefine and superstage S4 require REPLAN-REQUIRED for a scope-boundary change and preserve the approved leaf rather than overwriting it.

source_revision_changed.reason: A changed authoritative acceptance condition is an S4 commitment change; superrefine requires REPLAN-REQUIRED and S3/S5 cannot treat the old receipt as executable.

unrelated_head_advance.reason: superstage S5 requires a focused compatible baseline revalidation receipt for an unrelated HEAD advance, preserving the stage revision and commitments.

relevant_contract_advance.reason: superstage S4 treats a shared contract behavior and semantic-revision change as replanning; the stale consumer receipt is not executable and must not be overwritten in place.

missing_preparation_receipt.reason: The dormant post-Task-5 C6 recipe returns NEEDS-REFINEMENT for the first dependency-eligible upfront leaf without a current PREPARED receipt.

partially_executed_stage.reason: superrefine's entry gate and superstage S3 forbid in-place preparation once execution evidence exists; the established execution or CI recovery path owns it.
